LESSON: SAFETY ON RAISED PLATFORMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre – Technical Studies
Topic 1.1: Safety on Raised Platforms

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Safety on Raised Platforms. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the importance of observing safety when working on raised platforms?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks
2. describe risks associated with working on raised platforms
3. observe safety when working on raised platforms

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe risks associated with working on raised platforms
   In simple words: practise until you can describe risks associated with working on raised platforms. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. observe safety when working on raised platforms
   In simple words: practise until you can observe safety when working on raised platforms. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Safety on Raised Platforms using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Safety on Raised Platforms in the examples.
2. Explain Safety on Raised Platforms to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Safety on Raised Platforms.
4. Show that you can: identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Safety on Raised Platforms using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Safety on Raised Platforms important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss ways of minimising risks related to working on raised platforms,
2. Role-play safety practices for working on raised platforms,
3. Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when discussing ways of minimising risks and dangers related to working on raised platforms.
4. Digital Literacy: learner acquires interacting with technology skills when using digital devices to search for information on risks associated with working on raised platforms. Values:
5. Unity: learner develops positive relationships as they discuss ways of minimising risks related to working on raised platforms.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of raised platforms used in performing tasks
2. describe risks associated with working on raised platforms
3. observe safety when working on raised platforms

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
